title: LinkedIn Recommendations & Endorsements
subtitle: Direct feedback and professional endorsements from engineering leads, architects, and colleagues on LinkedIn.

testimonials.name: Ayush Panwar
testimonials.headline: PySpark, SQL, Databricks, Airflow, AWS | Building scalable data platforms
testimonials.context: Ayush worked with Vivek on different teams
testimonials.quote:
I am writing to highly recommend Vivek for his exceptional skills as an Data Engineer. Having had the pleasure of working closely with Vivek on a project, I can confidently say that he possesses a profound expertise in building scalable data pipelines on the Azure platform.

Vivek's dedication and passion for his work are truly admirable. He consistently demonstrated his ability to develop innovative solutions for our company, ensuring seamless data flow and integration. His thorough understanding of Azure's capabilities and his expertise in leveraging tools and technologies allowed us to effectively manage and analyze large volumes of data.

One of the aspects that impressed me the most about Vivek was his meticulous attention to detail. No matter how complex the task or challenging the problem, Vivek was always able to break it down and provide a well-structured solution. His commitment to maintaining data accuracy and integrity was evident throughout the entire process.

Vivek is an exceptional data engineer with a strong grasp of building scalable data pipelines and optimizing ETL processes. His expertise in Python, Spark, SQL, Azure has been invaluable in driving data-driven decision-making.
